name: Icy bangle with floating green
why: A clean, clear base with a wisp of green like waterweed drifting in a stream — lively, never heavy.
details: Icy base with vivid green floating flowers, round-bar bangle. Under light it has a soft floating glow, and it's understated enough for everyday wear. Size: 56 mm.

name: Mutton-fat white teardrop pendant
why: A warm, gentle white that never looks harsh. Beautifully oily — no carving needed to show off the material.
details: Xinjiang seed material, very white and fine, with a natural oily luster. A plain teardrop shape; lovely on a thin gold chain.

name: Lavender cabochon ring
why: A soft pinkish lavender that feels vintage in a gold setting.
details: Glutinous-icy lavender cabochon with an even, pink-leaning color. Set in 18k yellow gold with a full, rounded dome — perfect for autumn and winter.

name: Icy white drop earrings
why: Almost colorless and crystal clear — they make you look fresh and clean.
details: High-icy colorless drops set in 18k gold. They sway gently as you move, and light shines right through them.

name: Green nephrite bead bracelet
why: A calm spinach green, perfectly round beads, and they'll only get shinier with wear.
details:
Green nephrite round beads, about 8 mm, with even color and few black specks.
When choosing green nephrite, watch for black specks and fissures — the purer and more even the color, the better.

name: Seed-material melon handpiece with skin
why: The carver followed the pebble's natural shape and turned a patch of jujube-red skin into the melon vine.
details: Seed material with its original skin, carved to use the skin color. Just the right size to hold and rub every day.

name: Clear-water safety clasp
why: A light, even green like the sky after rain — and a lovely meaning too.
details: Clear-water green safety clasp: pale, even color on a transparent base. A safety clasp wishes for peace and a life that feels complete.

name: Green nephrite oval bangle
why: The oval "imperial consort" shape hugs the wrist, and the green has a classical elegance.
details: Green nephrite oval bangle with rich color. The oval shape follows the hand, so it doesn't slide around as much.
